items.title: Discover
items.summary: Understand the business, goals, users and existing workflows.
activities: Audit of current tools, data and integration points
Constraints, compliance needs and success metrics
items.output: A written problem definition everyone agrees on.

items.title: Plan
items.summary: Define the architecture, technology stack and automation strategy.
activities: Scoped delivery plan with milestones and risks
items.output: An architecture and a plan you can hold us to.

items.title: Build
items.summary: Design, develop and integrate the complete solution.
activities: Interface design against a shared design system
Incremental delivery with a usable environment each cycle
Integrations, automated tests and evaluation of AI behaviour
items.output: Working software in a real environment, every cycle.

items.title: Launch & Optimize
items.summary: Deploy, monitor and continuously improve the system.
activities: Staged rollout with monitoring and alerting in place
Measurement against the metrics agreed in discovery
items.output: A monitored system and a prioritised improvement backlog.
